sources.entry: React Native Debugger - Desktop app for inspecting your React Native projects. macOS, Linux, and Windows.

summary.one_liner: A standalone desktop app for debugging React Native apps, built on the official Remote Debugger with added React Inspector, Redux DevTools, and Apollo Client DevTools.
summary.what_it_does: The app is based on the official React Native Remote Debugger and adds more functionality. It includes React Inspector from react-devtools-core for inspecting components. It includes Redux DevTools with the same API as redux-devtools-extension, so Redux state can be inspected in the app. It also includes Apollo Client DevTools as a devtools extension. The README says it is distributed as prebuilt binaries from the release page, with Homebrew Cask and Arch Linux AUR install options. A compatibility table ties app versions to react-native versions (for example, >= 0.11 pairs with >= 0.62).
use_cases: debug a React Native app on desktop
debug React Native on macOS, Linux, or Windows
how_to_run: Download a prebuilt binary from the release page
git clone the react-native-debugger-bin AUR repo, then run makepkg -si
See docs/contributing.md for building from source
notable: Built on the official React Native Remote Debugger with extra functionality
Bundles React Inspector, Redux DevTools, and Apollo Client DevTools
Redux DevTools uses the same API as redux-devtools-extension
Available via Homebrew Cask and Arch Linux AUR
Documentation covers shortcuts, network inspect, and config file in home directory
caveats: The README says it only supports the old Remote Debugger; new debugger support (Hermes / JSI / New Architecture) is discussed in discussion #774
Requires a matching react-native version per the compatibility table (for example, >= 0.62 for app version >= 0.11)
Documentation for v0.10 is on a separate branch
